metadata.description: Static recompilation of Rollcage Stage II (PlayStation). Owned-input kit: you supply your own disc and BIOS.

releases.name: v0.1.0
releases.body:
# Rollcage Stage II v0.1.0 (Wave 4 owned-input setup kit)

You supply your own SLUS-00867 disc image (Redump CUE/BIN, or a CHD of the same dump) and your own SCPH-1001 (USA) BIOS dump. First-run setup generates and compiles the game on your machine. No disc, BIOS, generated game code, or save is included.

| Package | File | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows x64 | `rollcagestageii-0.1.0-windows-x64.zip` | `91c8058c6c335ca81ddad2c93d4ec8e2b42b43e18200a803559b18e7fa3cc5bb` |
| Linux x64 | `rollcagestageii-0.1.0-linux-x64.zip` | `3dd57be8e706ed74249878c4a5c5154d6b81f9b23a241ef2b016179e15c4f2bf` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `rollcagestageii-0.1.0-macos-arm64.zip` | `f79c5364ebb3f176b223326fe9c5b9ee942ea9eec1356787bb5cf4dd1ae6fa8e` |
| macOS Intel | `rollcagestageii-0.1.0-macos-x64.zip` | `2b71af597f696924750b7c9d5b09f05d7da1960c405c1426f5ed21df4ff5f518` |

`RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` and `SHA256SUMS.txt` bind the exact packages. Source: commit `5f9c56577b2e4b739a964593dcf03d479f31cb6f`.

Setup: extract the ZIP for your system into a writable folder, start `Rollcage_Stage_II` (`.exe` on Windows), select your disc image and BIOS in the wizard, choose Generate & rebuild. Windows downloads the portable build tools; Linux and macOS need CMake, Ninja, Python 3, and a C/C++ compiler on PATH.

Verified on this exact Windows package: clean-extract setup, generation, compilation of the normal and diagnostic builds, marker toggle, headless start (1850 guest frames), diagnostics collector. All four packages passed the archive, payload, and native generator checks in CI. Not verified: gameplay on these packages, native Linux/macOS setup and gameplay; macOS builds are ad-hoc signed, not notarized. Play testing of the private builds this kit derives from is recorded in the README's Status section, with the known issues.

Diagnostic mode: create an empty `diagnostic-mode.txt` next to `Rollcage_Stage_II` (or run `Rollcage_Stage_II --diagnostic`), reproduce the problem, then run `Rollcage_Stage_II --collect-diagnostics` and attach the resulting `diagnostics-<date>.zip` to a GitHub issue here.

Framework: psxrecomp (pinned fork commit in the `psxrecomp` submodule); launcher: recomp-ui (pinned in `recomp-ui`). Developed with AI assistance; Alex tests the game and makes release decisions. The original game and its trademarks belong to their respective owners.

# Rollcage Stage II [![GitHub downloads (all assets, all releases)](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Alexbeav/rollcage-stage-ii-recomp/total)](https://github.com/Alexbeav/rollcage-stage-ii-recomp/releases) [![GitHub downloads (latest release)](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Alexbeav/rollcage-stage-ii-recomp/latest/total)](https://github.com/Alexbeav/rollcage-stage-ii-recomp/releases/latest) [![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Alexbeav/rollcage-stage-ii-recomp)](https://github.com/Alexbeav/rollcage-stage-ii-recomp/releases/latest) Static recompilation of **Rollcage Stage II** built on [psxrecomp](https://github.com/mstan/psxrecomp) and [recomp-ui](https://github.com/RetroPortingToolKit/recomp-ui). This is an owned-input setup kit. You supply your own SLUS-00867 disc image and your own SCPH-1001 (USA) BIOS dump; first-run setup generates and compiles the game on your machine. The kit and its release archives contain no game disc, retail BIOS, generated game code, or saved game. | | | |---|---| | Region | USA | | Disc serial | SLUS-00867 | | Discs | 1 | | Supported dump | Redump `Rollcage Stage II (USA).cue` as CUE/BIN or CHD | | BIOS | SCPH-1001 (USA), 524288 bytes, SHA-256 `71af94d1e47a68c11e8fdb9f8368040601514a42a5a399cda48c7d3bff1e99d3` | ## Setup 1. Download the setup ZIP for your platform from [Releases](https://github.com/Alexbeav/rollcage-stage-ii-recomp/releases) and extract it into a writable folder. 2. Start `Rollcage_Stage_II` (`.exe` on Windows). 3. In the setup wizard select your disc image (the Redump CUE, or a CHD of the same dump) and your BIOS file. 4. Run Generate & rebuild and wait for the game to start. The first run compiles the game and takes several minutes. On Windows the wizard downloads the portable build tools (cmake-clang-v1) or uses cmake/ninja already on PATH. On Linux and macOS install CMake, Ninja, Python 3, and a C/C++ compiler first. Keep a CUE and every file it references together. Setup produces both a normal and a diagnostic build; see *Diagnostic mode* below. ## Retro Launcher You can run this title **standalone** (release zip + the built-in recomp-ui Generate & Build flow), or manage installs, updates, ROM/BIOS wiring, and queued builds more intuitively with **[Retro Launcher](https://github.com/RetroPortingToolKit/Retro-Launcher)** — the Retro Compilation Manager hub for self-compiling recomps. [Downloads](https://github.com/RetroPortingToolKit/Retro-Launcher/releases) · [Full README & features](https://github.com/RetroPortingToolKit/Retro-Launcher#readme)

Retro checks for updates, rebuilds with existing build data when possible, shares the portable toolchain used by per-title launchers, and automates BIOS/ROM/save plumbing so you are not stuck repeating each game’s wizard by hand. ## Status Version 0.1.0 release candidate. - Windows: the exact setup package passed automated clean-extract setup, generation, compilation, and a headless start check on the pinned framework. - Windows play testing on the private build this kit derives from: reported Playable at the first operator tally (September 12, 2026). - Linux and macOS: packages are built by CI from the same recipe; native setup and gameplay have not been verified. Full-game completion, audio fidelity, and multiplayer are not claimed. Runtime snapshots from older builds are not qualified compatible; ordinary memory-card saves are preserved across updates. ## Known issues - This disc has audio tracks. Select the CUE (or a CHD made from the full dump) so every track is mounted; a Track 01-only BIN fails verification. ## Diagnostic mode If the game crashes, freezes, or misbehaves, switch to the diagnostic build that first-run setup already produced (no recompiling): create an empty file named `diagnostic-mode.txt` next to `Rollcage_Stage_II.exe` and start the game as usual, or run `Rollcage_Stage_II.exe --diagnostic`. Reproduce the problem, quit, then run `Rollcage_Stage_II.exe --collect-diagnostics`: it writes `diagnostics-.zip` next to the exe. Attach that zip to a GitHub issue on this repository with a short description of what you did. The zip holds only the runtime's report files, never saves, BIOS, or disc images. Delete `diagnostic-mode.txt` to go back to normal mode. Details: `psxrecomp/docs/DIAGNOSTIC_MODE.md`. ## Legal You must own the original game. Disc images under `disc/` are gitignored and must never be committed. Retail BIOS dumps are not redistributed and OpenBIOS is not shipped: this title is retail-BIOS-only, so first-run Generate needs your own legally dumped SCPH-1001 image. Default app icon: `assets/psxrecomp.ico` (and `.png` / `.svg`) — Retro-themed controller mark from `psxrecomp/assets/`. Windows builds embed it via `APP_ICON`. Box art is not shipped in this kit or its repository. Redistribution permission for third-party cover images is unresolved, so the launcher runs without one. ## About this project This project was developed with AI assistance. AI assists with code, documentation, and investigation; Alex tests the game and makes release decisions. Validation claims describe only the tests actually performed. ## Credits and licenses Framework: [psxrecomp](https://github.com/mstan/psxrecomp), built from the pinned fork commit named by the `psxrecomp` submodule. Launcher: [recomp-ui](https://github.com/RetroPortingToolKit/recomp-ui), pinned by the `recomp-ui` submodule. This kit's own files are under [LICENSE](LICENSE); third-party notices are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), and the framework and launcher licenses remain in their source directories. The original game and its trademarks belong to their respective owners. ---

releases.name: SpaceRanger v0.1.0
releases.body:
The first pre-release of **SpaceRanger**, a native Windows port of *Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue* (N64) made by statically recompiling the game with [N64: Recompiled](https://github.com/N64Recomp/N64Recomp) and rendering it with [RT64](https://github.com/rt64/rt64).

### **This release does not contain game assets. The original game is required to run it: Toy Story 2, N64, USA version** (`.z64`, `.n64` or `.v64`).

### How to play
1. Download `SpaceRanger-v0.1.0-windows-x64.zip` below and extract it.
2. Open the `SpaceRanger` folder and run `SpaceRanger.exe`.
3. On the title screen choose **Load ROM** and select your ROM (only needed once), then **Start Game**.

Requires Windows 10/11 64-bit and a GPU supporting Direct3D 12.0 (Shader Model 6) or Vulkan 1.2. If it crashes on startup, update your graphics drivers.

### Important notices
- **Intel graphics:** Older drivers may cause startup crashes or graphical glitches. If you run into trouble, get the latest compatible driver from [Intel](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/articles/000090440/graphics.html) or your laptop maker; Windows Update may not offer the newest one.
- **Security warnings:** This build is not digitally signed, so Windows or antivirus software may flag it as unfamiliar. Download it only from this release, compare the ZIP's SHA-256 with the value below, and review any warning before deciding whether to run it. A specific malware detection should be investigated rather than assumed to be a false positive.

### What's in this build
- Animated title screen with a purple and lime-green theme
- High framerate support: frame interpolation up to your monitor's refresh rate
- Widescreen and full draw distance
- In-game menus for graphics, controls (controller and keyboard) and sound

### Known issues
- Buzz can show a thin dark band around his waist.
- Some particles, projectiles and HUD slides are not interpolated yet.
- Frame pacing has mostly been tested on one PC. If you see stutter, please open an issue with your GPU and refresh rate.
- Sound effects can sometimes go away.
SHA-256 of the zip: `BFE1A4F5EADCEA9C3BD1B134857756150037369C29F993108CAE88C5F394CA7B`

Built with help from AI coding assistants: Anthropic's Claude, along with OpenAI's ChatGPT/Codex.

*Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Disney, Pixar, Activision, Traveller's Tales or Nintendo. Source code under GPL-3.0.*

readme:
# SpaceRanger

SpaceRanger is a project that uses [N64: Recompiled](https://github.com/N64Recomp/N64Recomp) to **statically recompile** *Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue* (Nintendo 64) into a native Windows port, rendered with [RT64](https://github.com/rt64/rt64).

### [Check out the latest release here](../../releases/latest).

### **This repository and its releases do not contain game assets. The original game is required to build or run this project.**

> **Status:** early pre-release (v0.1.0). The game is playable from start to finish, but still has work ahead of it, so expect rough edges. See [Known Issues](#known-issues).

## Table of Contents
* [System Requirements](#system-requirements)
* [Features](#features)
* [Planned Features](#planned-features)
* [FAQ](#faq)
* [Known Issues](#known-issues)
* [Building](#building)
* [Contributing](#contributing)
* [Libraries Used and Projects Referenced](#libraries-used-and-projects-referenced)
* [How This Was Made](#how-this-was-made)
* [License](#license)

## System Requirements
* Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.
* A GPU supporting Direct3D 12.0 (Shader Model 6) or Vulkan 1.2.

If the game crashes on startup, make sure your graphics drivers are fully up to date.

## Features

#### Plug and Play
Run `SpaceRanger.exe`, choose **Load ROM** on the title screen and select your copy of the North American (USA) version of the game, then start playing. There is no separate extraction step: assets are loaded from your copy of the game. `.z64`, `.n64` and `.v64` dumps all work. You can also place the ROM next to `SpaceRanger.exe` before the first launch and it will be found automatically.

#### High Framerate Support
The game logic still runs at its original rate, and RT64 generates in-between frames up to your monitor's refresh rate.

#### Widescreen
The view expands to fill widescreen displays.

#### Full Draw Distance
The original game's distance culling is removed, so objects and enemies are drawn across the whole level.

#### Easy-to-Use Menus
An animated title screen, plus in-game menus for graphics, controls and sound: resolution scaling, MSAA, refresh rate, window mode, and controller and keyboard bindings.

## Planned Features
* Interpolation for the remaining effects (particles, projectiles, HUD slides)
* Testing and fixes across every level
* Linux support
* Cheat codes
* Randomizer

## FAQ

#### What is static recompilation?
Static recompilation is the process of automatically translating an application from one platform to another. For more details, check out [N64: Recompiled](https://github.com/N64Recomp/N64Recomp).

#### Is this an emulator?
No. The game's code was translated to native code ahead of time. It is not an emulator, and it cannot run any arbitrary ROM.

#### Where is the savefile stored?
In the `spaceranger-config` folder next to `SpaceRanger.exe`, along with your settings and the validated copy of your ROM. The game always runs portably from its own folder.

#### How do I choose a different ROM?
**You don't.** This project only supports the US version of the N64 release of Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue. ROMs in byteswapped formats are converted automatically if they're the correct version. To start over with a fresh ROM, delete the `spaceranger-config` folder.

## Known Issues
* Buzz can show a thin dark band around his waist.
* Some particles, projectiles and HUD slides still move at the original frame rate instead of being interpolated.
* Frame pacing has mostly been tested on one PC. If you see stutter, please [open an issue](../../issues) with your GPU and refresh rate.
* Overlays such as MSI Afterburner can cause performance issues.
* Sound effects can sometimes go away.

## Building
Building is not required to play this project; prebuilt binaries, which do not contain game assets, are on the [Releases](../../releases) page. To build it yourself, see [docs/BUILDING.md](docs/BUILDING.md). You'll need your own ROM, since the recompiled game code is generated locally from it and is never committed.

## Contributing
Pull requests and bug reports are welcome; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Libraries Used and Projects Referenced
* [N64: Recompiled](https://github.com/N64Recomp/N64Recomp) for the static recompiler
* [N64ModernRuntime](https://github.com/N64Recomp/N64ModernRuntime) for the runtime that runs the recompiled code
* [RecompFrontend](https://github.com/N64Recomp/RecompFrontend) for the menus, input and launcher framework
* [RT64](https://github.com/rt64/rt64) for the project's rendering engine
* [RmlUi](https://github.com/mikke89/RmlUi) for building the menus
* [FreeType](https://freetype.org/) for font rendering, used by RmlUi
* [SDL2](https://www.libsdl.org/) for windowing, input and audio
* [Fredoka](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Fredoka) and [Bungee](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Bungee) fonts for the title screen
* [Zelda64Recomp](https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/Zelda64Recomp) and [BanjoRecomp](https://github.com/BanjoRecomp/BanjoRecomp) as reference projects

## How This Was Made
SpaceRanger was built with heavy help from AI coding assistants: Anthropic's [Claude](https://claude.ai) (recompilation setup, renderer and frame-interpolation work, testing tools, the title screen and its art, packaging), along with OpenAI's ChatGPT/Codex. All of it was directed and play-tested by the project's author.

## License
This project's own code and title-screen art are released under the [GPL-3.0](LICENSE) license, the same as Zelda64Recomp and BanjoRecomp. Dependencies and fonts keep their own licenses (see [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES](tools/release/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt)).

*SpaceRanger is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Disney, Pixar, Activision, Traveller's Tales or Nintendo. Toy Story and all related names are trademarks of their respective owners.*
